American Alligator.name: American Alligator
American Alligator.about: Class 7, hard difficulty animal with a max level of 9 and a max weight of 530 kg. Found in: Mississippi Acres Preserve.
American Alligator.notes: greatOne is false because cotwguide shows no '10 Fabled' level; this was not checked against patch notes from 2026. cotwguide and the Steam chart give the same thresholds (226/378/492, max 530) for both American Alligator and Eastern Gray Kangaroo; one of them is probably copied. Treat as unverified. Bronze threshold and minimum weight are not given by either source. Furs come from a third-party list; it says nothing about how rare each fur is in percentage terms. The Steam chart (Mississippi Acres; level 2-9, class 7) is the source for integrity ammo. Its page now shows a 'removed from the community' notice, so treat it as secondary.
